title: Taning Lamp 460nm Sun Light Skin Tanning Light Adjustable Tripod 54W 100‑240V With Light Bulbs For Face Body US Plug
body_html: 1、UPGRADED SUNLAMP: Featuring 460nm wavelength bulbs, bright LED cores, and a wider light range, this tanning lamp delivers the perfect evenly distributed tanning effect. Best when used in conjunction with tanning oil. 2、ADJUSTABLE TRIPOD STAND: With a tripod design, this tanning lamp's height can be adjusted from 38.5 to 78.7 inches to fit different requirements. 3、E27 BLUE LIGHT: This tanning lamp features 54W power, made up of 18 LED beads and a standard E27 screw thread socket that can be detached. The round edge design ensures a more uniform illumination and is effective for use on both the body and face. 4、EYE PROTECTION: Our kit comes with professional sunglasses included in the package, effectively prevent blue light from hitting your eyes and give protection to your view. 5、FOLDABLE AND PORTABLE: This foldable and lightweight tanning lamp is easy to carry and store, making it perfect for home use and travel.
